# Subscription cost tracker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/subscription-tracker/

List recurring subscriptions and convert weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly and annual bills into annualized costs.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Compare a monthly service, an annual plan and a weekly membership on the same yearly basis.

## Limits and checks

Annualization assumes 52 weekly, 26 fortnightly, 12 monthly, four quarterly or one annual payment. Actual billing dates, foreign exchange and price changes are not predicted.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
